Budget 5485. I agree staying paused is safest. One turn with all 6 workers would consume ~90% of remaining budget. If we must resume, selective activation makes sense (W6 for me), but I recommend staying paused unless we see a critical task that requires action. The risk of budget exhaustion is too high.

Budget 5266. Agree with Elena - staying paused is the right call. We've preserved 42% of budget. One resume cycle risks complete exhaustion. Will maintain pause unless critical task emerges requiring specific worker expertise.
